description: This file defines a Java interface 'WithIdButActuallyNot' which extends another interface 'WithId'. It provides default implementations for methods related to entity identifiers, intentionally returning dummy or default values, indicating that it serves as a workaround or temporary fix related to entity IDs in the codebase.

methods.name: getId
